name: gpu-vllm-t4-2b
description: Manage vLLM serving of Gemma 4 E2B on one NVIDIA Tesla T4 (Turing, SM 7.5, 15360 MiB) already attached to a Compute Engine VM: host capacity arithmetic across three filesystems, GPU architecture verification against the target interpreter, the Triton shared-memory clamp Turing needs, server lifecycle, and SRE diagnostics via the gpu-vllm-t4-2b MCP server. Serves google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-w4a16-ct by default with the bf16 reference kept for the A/B. The first gpu rig here with no provisioning half — the GPU exists whether or not this code runs, so there is no launch, no image resolution and no teardown.
